dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Alas Strait and Included Anchorages
dct_description_sm: From Netherlands Government surveys to 1906 ; Published Nov., 1919, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
Conversion Table, Authorities text, navigational notes, Malayan and English Terms, 3 inset charts.
Soundings are in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows depths, low water, reefs, coasts, islands.

Chart 1. Alas Strait ; Natural Scale 1:201,770 -- Chart 2. Alast Strait: Northern Entrance ; Natural Scale 1:75,209 [Inset 1. Lombok - East Coast: Pijut Bay to Tanjung Ringgit -- Inset 2. Sumbawa - West Coast: Kertasari and Taliwang (Chereweh) Bays -- Inset 3. Lombok - East Coast: Labuanhaji Road.
